maria: FYI small regression after I tweaked the package `exports` in the JS SDK — Next/Vercel edge builds now error with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. repro in examples/quickstart-next.

aj: ugh. which package and can you paste the exact error + your `exports` block?

maria: package is `@redwood/inference-js` (we renamed from `redwood-inference-js`). build log excerpt: 
```
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'redwood-inference-js' imported from /vercel/path/to/examples/quickstart-next/.vercel/output/functions/edge/handler/index.mjs
```
My current `package.json` `exports`: 
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "browser": "./dist/esm/browser.mjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

sam: edge runtimes and some bundlers are picky about conditional maps. two practical fixes: add a top-level string fallback (so older resolvers can pick it up) and add a `types` entry so TS inference works for samples. e.g. in package.json: 
```
"exports": {
  ".": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "browser": "./dist/esm/browser.mjs"
  }
},
"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
```
(or the conditional map plus the fallback string at the same level). Also consider adding a `node` conditional and/or `default` fallback.

aj: i'll draft a small PR to: add "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", add a top-level fallback string for `.`, and include a tiny CI check script `scripts/check-exports.js` that validates resolution from an edge-like ESM environment.

devrel: this matches a CX bug we saw — folks using Next Edge or Cloudflare Workers hit this silently. please add a short troubleshooting note in onboarding docs and update quickstart to pin to the patch if needed.

maria: for immediate customer impact i'm reverting the exports-only change and will publish a patch with the fallback + types. starting the release PR now. :thumbsup:

build-bot: Release PR #1278 opened by maria -> `fix(exports): add fallback & types`

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1278 contains the minimal fallback, `types`, and a unit test for the package resolution. planning to ship the patch in the next 30-60 minutes.

aj: i'll follow up and add the CI export-resolution test in a follow-up PR.

sam: let's also add a short postmortem note in eng docs so we don't re-land an incompatible exports-only change.

maria: agreed. closing the loop after the patch release.
